title: Conference handover marks stage Upgraded before the invites and the 1:1 discard are sent; a refused send is never retried
trigger: Add people to a 1:1 call; the conference gets its link; the sender refuses discardCall (client closing or native error)
effect: 1:1 call stays up with the conference already running; the peer never receives the link and the handover is not retried
fix: Move to Upgraded only after discard_call_with_link went out, keep Handover on a refused send so the next ingest retries
